goalZh: 会用 Would you like…? / I'd like… 礼貌地问和要,用 Can I…? 问能不能做某事
canDoZh: 能在飞机上听懂空乘的询问,礼貌地点饮料、要东西,问可不可以做某事

newItems.noteZh: 不分男女都这么叫;重音在 FLIGHT 上。
比 Do you want…? 客气,服务员、空乘常这么问;回答 Yes, please. / No, thank you.;Would you 连读成 /ˈwʊdʒə/。
I'd = I would;I'd like some water, please.;后面接动词时要加 to:I'd like to…(第 6 单元)。
th 是清音 /θ/,舌尖轻咬;ir 读 /ɝː/,要卷舌;别和 thirty(三十)搞混。
orange juice(橙汁);结尾 ge 读 /dʒ/;以元音开头,说 an orange。
bl 连读,an 读 /æŋ/;a blanket(一条毯子)。
美式 chips 是薯片,英式 chips 是薯条(美式叫 fries,第 4 单元学过);ch 读 /tʃ/。
Would you like some more water?(要再来点水吗?)some 弱读成 /səm/,more 美式卷舌。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Lei, look! The flight attendant is coming.
lines.zh: (飞机起飞后)磊,你看!空乘推着车过来了。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Hi! Would you like something to drink?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes, please. I'd like some water. I'm thirsty.
lines.zh: 好的,谢谢。我要一杯水。我渴了。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Water? Lei, really? I'd like orange juice and a blanket, please.
lines.zh: 还喝水?磊,真的吗?我要一杯橙汁和一条毯子,谢谢。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Sure. Would you like a snack? We have cookies or chips.
lines.zh: 好的。要来点零食吗?有饼干,也有薯片。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Chips, please! And can I get up now?
lines.zh: 薯片,谢谢!还有,我现在能起来吗?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Sorry, not right now. Please wear your seatbelt.
lines.zh: 抱歉,现在还不行。请系好安全带。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: OK... Sofia, I really need the restroom!
lines.zh: 好吧……索菲亚,我真的很想去洗手间!

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: OK, you can get up now. Would you like some more water?
lines.zh: (二十分钟后)好了,现在可以起身了。还要再来点水吗?

questions.explainZh: I'd like some water. I'm thirsty.(橙汁是索菲亚要的。)

questions.prompt: 磊想起身去洗手间,空乘一开始怎么说?
options: 现在不行,请系好安全带
questions.explainZh: Sorry, not right now. Please wear your seatbelt.(过了一会儿才可以起身。)

questions.prompt: 空乘最后问磊还要不要水,磊怎么回答?
questions.explainZh: Would you like some more water? —— No, thank you!(他正急着去洗手间呢。)

grammar.titleZh: Would you like…? / I'd like…:礼貌地问和要
grammar.bodyZh: Would you like…?(您要……吗?)是礼貌地问对方要不要某样东西,比 Do you want…? 客气,空乘、服务员常这么问。回答:Yes, please. / No, thank you.。说自己想要什么,礼貌的说法是 I'd like + 名词(I'd = I would):I'd like some water, please.;第 6 单元学过 I'd like to + 动词(I'd like to return this.)。问要不要再来一些:Would you like some more water?。发音:Would you 连读成 /ˈwʊdʒə/,d 和 y 合成 /dʒ/;would 的 l 不发音。

examples.text: Would you like something to drink? — Yes, please.
examples.zh: 想喝点什么吗?——好的,谢谢。

examples.text: Would you like some more water? — No, thank you.
examples.zh: 还要再来点水吗?——不用了,谢谢。

grammar.bodyZh: 问自己能不能做某事,用 Can I…?:Can I get up now?(我现在能起来吗?)。回答:Sure. / Sorry, not right now.。这里的 can 表示“允许”,和上一课 You can't have water after security. 是同一个意思。要东西时也常说 Can I get…?(第 4 单元学过),比 I want… 礼貌得多。

examples.text: Can I get up now? — Sorry, not right now.
examples.zh: 我现在能起来吗?——抱歉,现在不行。

examples.text: Can I get a blanket? — Sure.
examples.zh: 能给我一条毯子吗?——当然。
